facts.statement: The SOE Trick-or-Treat Event in late October 2011 included Free Realms as a participating game, alongside other SOE titles.
facts.quote: Participating games include: EverQuest® EverQuest® II,;EverQuest® II Extended, DC Universe™ Online, Free Realms®

article_summaries.title: Trick-or-Treat! Double Your Treats on 10/29/11!
article_summaries.summary: This is a site-wide SOE news post, hosted on the Free Realms news page, announcing a Trick-or-Treat promotion for 29 October 2011 that doubled Station Cash for any SOE Pre-Paid Game Card redeemed or Station Cash purchased. Free Realms is only one of several listed participating games, so the post gives no Free Realms-specific details beyond its inclusion. The post's exact date is not shown; the capture page says it was posted 2 days and 22 hours before the 2011-11-01 capture.
